ABOUT US

AHS Catering and Events is a leading Dubai catering company with more than 20 years of excellence in luxury weddings, corporate functions, and private celebrations. From intimate gatherings to large-scale galas, we craft tailored menus that blend authentic Middle Eastern flavors with refined international cuisine, all prepared in halal-certified kitchens.

AHS is featured on cateringindubai.com as one of the best catering companies in Dubai.

Global brands trust our team to impress their guests. Our client list includes MBC Group, Michelin, Dubai Mall, Gucci, Booking.com, Validus, Hyundai, Red Bull, Nestlé, Messara Living, the Romanian Consulate, Sephora, and many more. With AHS you gain a full-service partner that handles food, décor, and staffing under one roof, delivering flawless execution and unforgettable taste at every event.

MORE

THE FOUNDER

Ali Darwish’s journey didn’t start with a business plan. It began at 16, in the hospitality trenches polishing cutlery, serving tables, learning how timing, service, and human emotions shape an experience.

He mastered the front-of-house first reading guests, anticipating needs, delivering service that feels effortless. Then he moved into the kitchen, not to cook, but to understand: production, preparation systems, discipline, standards, consistency.

He knew this truth: “You can’t lead excellence if you don’t understand the details.”
Driven by curiosity, he traveled across Europe, Asia, and the Middle East not to collect recipes, but to gather inspiration from cultures, flavors, techniques, and emotions.

Managing Partner and Founder of EATLUX

Kristina Gilfanova leads Dubai’s premier boutique catering company, redefining luxury hospitality through culinary artistry and flawless execution.

Her creative direction blends global flavors, elegant aesthetics, and meticulous planning to deliver unforgettable corporate and private celebrations.

Under her vision, AHS Catering & Events has become the benchmark for refined, full-sensory experiences that embody both excellence and storytelling.

Our Services

From corporate gatherings to lavish weddings, private events, and exclusive yacht or jet experiences, we bring exceptional cuisine and seamless service to every setting. Whether you need a fully staffed bar, an authentic Majlis coffee experience, or professional staffing and equipment rental, our team ensures every detail is executed with excellence. No matter the occasion, we deliver flawless hospitality and unforgettable flavors, designed to elevate your event.

Trusted by

CORPORATE EVENTS

At AHS Catering & Events, we don’t simply cater corporate events
we elevate brands through food, service, and experience design.

From high-level boardroom meetings and product launches to conferences and VIP galas, our team delivers gourmet cuisine with impeccable presentation and world-class hospitality. Every detail is curated to reflect your brand standards the menu, the styling, the service flow, the way guests interact with the food.

We handle everything from A to Z: concept creation, menu design, staffing, setup, live stations, premium canapés service, equipment, and on-site coordination. Whether you need a refined pass-around canapé reception or a full service dining experience, we ensure your event feels organized, premium, and effortless.

Our clients trust us because:

– We understand corporate expectations precision, timing, consistency
– We execute flawlessly, regardless of event size
– We elevate the guest experience not just the food
– Your event becomes more than a gathering.
– It becomes a brand moment.

Professional. Seamless. Unforgettable.

MORE

PRIVATE EVENTS

Every event has a story and we bring it to life through unforgettable food and impeccable presentation.
At AHS Catering & Events, we transform private gatherings into immersive culinary experiences. Whether it’s an intimate chef-style dinner for 10 guests or a large celebration for 3,000, our team handles everything seamlessly: menu creation, planning, setup, staffing, execution, and service flow.

We don’t just serve food.
We design moments.
